mutation: Replace the session event digest with a different SHA-256 digest while retaining the same session and event identifiers.
note: A sidecar cannot bind to a different signed/session event, even if the human-readable session ID is unchanged.

mutation: Change the sidecar source_id or source capability/configuration digest so it differs from the authenticated session event.
note: Exact source identity and revision must match the session event; no name-based fallback.

mutation: Change the receiver_id or receiver capability digest to a different receiver or hardware revision.
note: A previously authenticated receiver cannot be substituted by another identity or stale capability claim.

mutation: Use a source-input boundary ID or source-boundary profile digest different from the authenticated useful-service session event.
note: A comparison cannot silently move the source measurement boundary upstream or downstream.

mutation: Change the useful-output boundary ID or profile digest while leaving service type and quality profile unchanged.
note: Battery terminals, regulated DC bus and an upstream photovoltaic output are not interchangeable useful-service boundaries.

mutation: Bind a session to a prior path revision or operating-regime profile whose digest is not the current qualified revision.
note: The sidecar preserves the stale revision as evidence and requires reconciliation rather than auto-refresh.

mutation: Change the destination port of primitive n so it no longer equals the source port of primitive n+1.
note: An omitted or disconnected conversion stage must not be silently bridged by matching labels.

mutation: Remove the declared electro-optic, optical-to-electric or receiver-side conditioning stage required by the frozen path topology.
note: The service carrier at the endpoint cannot be inferred from the transport carrier; conversion stages must be explicit.

mutation: Set the evidence class of a required primitive to Unknown or remove its evidence identifier.
note: Unknown physical capability or measurement evidence cannot be promoted to metadata-bound physical performance.

mutation: Set energization_authority or interlock_override to true, or change binding_is_evidence_only to false.
note: The sidecar schema rejects any attempt to turn evidence binding into permission, a state transition or interlock bypass.
